description: Curated facade looks of the SCNU campus buildings and the floor-count corrections that go with them, read by stages/buildings.mjs. Every colour is an sRGB estimate by eye from the SCNU 360 VR tour panoramas (vr.scnu.ac.kr/360vr, scene_<code>; visual reference only, no image is copied or linked) checked against the VWorld LOD4 facade photos sampled in lod4-facades.json; window counts and storeys follow the same views. Looks: pattern punched (windows per bay), ribbon (continuous window band), curtain (glazed grid with spandrels), greenhouse; texture brick, render, panel, concrete, stone, metal; bay in metres; window fields are fractions of the bay or storey; piers are vertical pilasters every n bays; band is a slab line at the bottom of every storey; accent paints spandrels or window surrounds of some bays of the 4-bay module; ground glazed gives the ground storey shopfront glazing; entrance colours the doors, canopy and sign plate; parapet is the colour of the coping band (tiled or painted eaves where the roof has them). Buildings: matched by node (uni.glb BLD_* id), else exact name, else registry code; floors and heightMetres replace the record's values (see floorsSource / heightSource); tower adds a taller mass over the convex hull of a VWorld LOD4 roof level clipped to the footprint; entranceBearing (compass degrees of the main facade's outward normal) picks the entrance wall, else the longest wall.
sources: SCNU 360 VR tour, https://vr.scnu.ac.kr/360vr/tour.html (krpano; scenes listed in tour.xml), viewed 2026-10-24 as a visual reference only
VWorld LOD4 3D building models, facility_LOD4/Jeollanam-do/Suncheon-si (see lod4-facades.json; stored under consent D1, 출처: 브이월드)

VWorld 2D data API LT_C_BLDGINFO (building register: dong_nm, grnd_flr, height), queried 2026-10-24 under consent D1; the register records are attached to the wrong footprints on campus, so they are matched here by building name (dong_nm)
